title: Mixed Event — Relaxing Tea Time — Episode2 Help Arrives

meta.Event Outline: In the lead-up to White Day, Kanade begins thinking about how to express her gratitude for the Valentine's chocolate she received, as well as for all the help she's been given. As she's struggling to think of gifts, she learns that Ichika is having the same dilemma, and the two team up!

rows.Line: The next day
Diner

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: ...is probably the best way I know to get a bass drum to sound more punchy.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see. I didn't know that was possible...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Nod*
It's common for bass drums to create a lot of unwanted noise, but an equalizer can help you get the sound you want by filtering all that out.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, you should try reading this book if you have time. It discusses this topic in much further detail.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, thank you so much!
If you're sure, then I'll borrow this for a little while.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Where do I begin to thank you...
You've given me such a thorough explanation after I asked you to meet me on such short notice.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, I'm just glad that I could help you...
So, have you gotten used to composing on a computer?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hmm, there's still so much I don't know. I actually stayed up really late last night working on a song...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But my hope is that I'll soon be able to produce songs the way I imagine them as easily as you do, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: And I'm sure you will.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Please feel free to contact me again.
I'll try to answer your questions as best I can.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sorry. I didn't realize I was this hungry...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Then, why don't we get a quick bite to eat?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes, please!
Alright, what's on the menu... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: “Only available on White Day”...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Gratin with white sauce, roasted marshmallow cakes, tarts topped with towers of whipped cream... They have quite a lot on here.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They do...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Hoshino...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, um...
This menu made me think about White Day is all..

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The thing is, I haven't been able to decide what I'm going to get everyone for White Day.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You too?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? Does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes...
I've also been having the same problem.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Really? You too?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. I still haven't been able to decide either...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's so hard. Especially after hearing all my friends say that they'll be happy with whatever I get them.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, actually... I was told the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. We're in the same boat.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
We are...
At the same time, I'd probably answer the same way as everyone if I were asked what I wanted.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
But that's the strange part...
It's always so hard to decide what to get when you're the one doing the giving.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: True...
We couldn't help but overhear your conversation!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Minori...! Oh, Momoi's with you...!
How long have you two been here?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We apologize for eavesdropping.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But your conversation caught our attention while we were discussing an idea for a stream.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, I see...
I wish we'd noticed sooner.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's okay because...we might be able to help with your problem!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're both wondering about what to give everyone for White Day, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We actually got a question about that during one of our streams and were just in the middle of planning a special segment in response!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
We're calling it...
The White Day Gift Showcase Special!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sh-Showcase...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Does that mean you're going to recommend gifts for White Day?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's right, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Someone by the name of OneMillionFriends sent us the question I just mentioned, and they're having trouble deciding what to get everyone for White Day.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: One million friends...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's probably just their handle, but I'm guessing they do have a lot of friends to worry about.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I see...
So, what did they ask specifically?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What was it now...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
“Dear Minori,
I'm a huge fan of you and MORE MORE JUMP! I'm having trouble deciding what to get all my friends for White Day.”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: “Despite my limited budget, I want to get everyone something really nice. What would you all do in this kind of situation?”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: ...is what they wrote!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, you memorized the whole thing...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. They did say that they're a huge fan of mine.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, we're turning this person's idea into an entire segment about affordable White Day gifts!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, that's just what we need...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I guess we're not alone.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Now do you see?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We were just about to browse around a few shops to see what's out there...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, why don't you two join us?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Of course!
We've been looking up what kinds of snacks and sweets everyone's buying, so we can all go look at those in person today.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And it would also be great to get an outsider's perspective.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Right!
Just browsing, no cameras! So you should both come with us!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you, Hanasato and... Um...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I'm Airi Momoi.
It's nice to meet you, Yoisaki!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Nice to meet you too.
